description: This file is the entry point for a React-based frontend application. It initializes the React app by attaching it to the DOM, renders the root component, and sets up strict mode for development checks.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a React root to enable rendering of React components into the specified DOM element.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree into the DOM node associated with the root.
